intro: A blinding light splits the sky, and {{arceusName}} descends to test your resolve.
title: The Arceus Trial
description: {{arceusName}} regards you in silence, its thousand-plate form shimmering with every type at once. This feels like far more than an ordinary encounter.

1.label: Accept the trial
1.tooltip:
(-) Extremely Tough Battle
(+) Unlocks the Heavenly Flute
1.selected: {{arceusName}} raises its plates. The trial begins!

2.label: Turn away
2.selected: You decide this is not a trial you're ready for, and leave.

outro: {{arceusName}} nods once, satisfied, and fades into light. You feel that something has changed.
